semiconductor_relevance: Medium — MFOPTEX manufactures silica-based optical fiber products that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly for applications requiring UV-resistant fibers.
summary: MFOPTEX specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of silica-based optical fiber products, including large-diameter optical fibers suitable for a wide wavelength range. Their UV-resistant optical fibers are particularly relevant for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, providing reliable transmission even under long-term ultraviolet exposure.
capabilities: Tailored optical fiber solutions for semiconductor applications
